Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels
    Case 2: c.SeriesCollection(2).HasDataLabels = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(2).HasDataLabels
    Case 3: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = False: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels
    Case 4: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = False: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels
    Case 5: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels
    Case 6: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel
    Case 7: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = False: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel
    Case 8: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 9: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": r = c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 10: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).DataLabel.Text = "Q": c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(2).DataLabel.Text
    Case 11: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "R": r = c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).DataLabel.Text = "Z": r = c.SeriesCollection(2).Points(2).DataLabel.Text
    Case 13: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = False: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel
    Case 14: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowCategoryName = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowCategoryName
    Case 15: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowSeriesName = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowSeriesName
    Case 16: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowCategoryName = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowValue = False: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowValue
    Case 17: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Position = xlLabelPositionInsideEnd: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Position
    Case 18: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.NumberFormat = "0.0": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.NumberFormat
    Case 19: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.ShowCategoryName = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Separator = "; ": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels.Separator
    Case 20: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.ShowCategoryName = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.ShowCategoryName
    Case 21: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Position = xlLabelPositionInsideBase: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Position
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set c = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function
